title: PMK 131/2024: statutory 12% PPN with DPP Nilai Lain 11/12
summary: From 1 January 2025 the statutory PPN rate is 12%. Supplies other than PPnBM luxury goods use a nilai lain base of 11/12, so the stated effective rate stays 11%. Luxury goods use 12% on the full base, with a one-month delay for sales to final consumers.

legal_basis.title: UU HPP, jadwal tarif 12%
legal_basis.instrument: UU No. 7 Tahun 2021, Pasal 7 ayat (1) huruf b UU PPN

verification.notes: Wording checked against the PMK PDF text and the DJP explainer. Not a legal opinion.

changes.summary: The statutory PPN rate applied by PMK 131 is 12%, the rate UU HPP required by 1 January 2025 at the latest.

computation.notes: 12% is the statutory multiplier. The base is not always the full price; see the nilai lain change.

migration_impact.summary: Invoice tax engines must store 12% as the statutory rate from 1 January 2025 and must not keep writing 11% as the statutory rate.

before.description: Pasal 7 ayat (1) huruf a, in force through 31 December 2024.

after.description: PMK 131 Pasal 2 ayat (2) and Pasal 3 ayat (2).

changes.summary: For imports and supplies of non-luxury BKP, supplies of JKP, and use of offshore intangible BKP or offshore JKP, the DPP is nilai lain of 11/12 of the import value, selling price, or compensation. 12% times 11/12 is an 11% effective charge.

computation.notes: Other pre-existing DPP Nilai Lain and besaran tertentu rules are excluded by PMK 131 Pasal 4 and are not in this diff.

migration_impact.summary: A system that multiplies 12% by the full invoice amount will overcharge non-luxury supplies. Persist both the 11/12 base and the stated 11% equivalent, and keep them off luxury invoices that use the full base.

before.description: 11% on the ordinary DPP through 31 December 2024.

changes.summary: Luxury BKP that are subject to PPnBM are charged at 12% of harga jual or nilai impor, not of an 11/12 base. This does not set the PPnBM amount.

computation.notes: Pasal 5 delays this result for a final consumer until 1 February 2025.

migration_impact.summary: Product masters need a luxury-and-PPnBM flag. Final-consumer sales in January 2025 must use the transitional treatment instead of this one.

changes.summary: A luxury BKP supplied to a final consumer from 1 January 2025 through 31 January 2025 still uses 12% times nilai lain of 11/12 of the selling price.

migration_impact.summary: Point-of-sale systems need a buyer characteristic for konsumen akhir and a hard end date of 31 January 2025.

changes.summary: From 1 February 2025 a luxury BKP supplied to a final consumer uses Pasal 2 ayat (2): 12% of the selling price.

migration_impact.summary: Remove the January nilai lain path for final-consumer luxury goods on 1 February 2025.
